comment: Persons Unknown ward graybox fight stills. A live human walks the bundled development map with ordinary input, picks up the Tack and the Scatter, and fights three rooms of Clerks and Sweepers with accurate aim. There are no switches or gates; two arrivals advance the objectives. Accurate aim is capture evidence, not a difficulty review. Latch is an arrival stand-in. This is not playable M02.
